items.prompt: With c=2 and an initially empty ring, PUSH 4, PUSH 5, POP are applied. Which output prefix follows?

options.why: Two physical slots do not mean two usable payload slots in the one-empty-slot contract.
The first push fills the single usable slot; rejection preserves the stored 4.
An empty c=2 ring still has one usable slot.
A rejected push does not overwrite the accepted payload.

items.explanation: The first push fills the single usable slot; rejection preserves the stored 4.
